summary_bullets: Add a shared safe sourceable result-env reader for design orchestration
Move /design argv and init handoffs to rc-gated sourceable env files
Expand regression coverage for parser output, fallback parsing, and structural wiring
commit_message:
Add safe result-env reader for design handoffs

Add scripts/read-result-env.sh with a documented harness for allowlisted sourceable output, WARN/ERROR replay, symlink refusal, and fallback parsing. Extend parse-design-argv.sh with leading internal --output support while preserving the legacy uppercase stdout stream.

Update /design Step 0-pre and Step 0b init to source generated env files instead of hand-parsing KV streams, and wire Makefile, relevant checks, structure pins, and agent-lint coverage for the new harness.
